British police once explained consent with a cup of tea ☕

In 2015, Thames Valley Police released a video comparing consent to offering someone tea. If they say no thanks, don't make them tea. Someone who is asleep, drunk or passed out can't consent. People can change their mind at any time, a yes last time doesn't mean yes now, and silence isn't a yes.

If you can understand tea, you can understand consent.

Sources: Thames Valley Police via The Week, NHS Devon Sexual Health, Rape Crisis England & Wales, Queensland Health.

What's the clearest way you've ever heard consent explained?
